description: Create the Astro project scaffold in /website with i18n (EN+TR), Tailwind CSS, dark mode, and all page routes. This is the foundation feature that sets up the entire site structure including layouts, components, navigation, footer, and all page stubs with real content pulled from project docs.
steps: Initialize Astro project in /projects/sandbox/keyflip/website with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, and @astrojs/sitemap integration
Configure astro.config.mjs with i18n routing (EN default, TR secondary), site URL placeholder, and static output mode suitable for GitHub Pages / Cloudflare Pages
Set up Tailwind CSS with a developer-focused color palette and dark mode (class-based toggle)
Create base layout (src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro) with: HTML lang attribute from locale, meta tags for SEO, Open Graph tags, dark mode toggle, responsive viewport, font loading (Inter or similar)

Create shared components: Header (nav with language switcher + mobile hamburger menu), Footer (GitHub link, MIT license, author credit), Hero section, FeatureCard, CodeBlock (syntax-highlighted install commands), CommandReference (for CLI docs), DarkModeToggle

Create EN pages: src/pages/index.astro (landing/hero), src/pages/features.astro, src/pages/docs/index.astro, src/pages/docs/installation.astro, src/pages/docs/usage.astro, src/pages/docs/cli-reference.astro, src/pages/docs/providers.astro, src/pages/docs/sessions.astro, src/pages/docs/fleet.astro, src/pages/docs/mcp.astro, src/pages/architecture.astro, src/pages/use-cases.astro, src/pages/pricing.astro, src/pages/faq.astro
Create TR pages mirroring the EN structure under src/pages/tr/ with full Turkish content translated from the TR docs already available in the project

Landing page content: tagline ('Multi-account switcher for Claude Code & AI tools'), key value props (zero dependencies, cross-platform, 130+ commands, MCP support, fleet management), install code blocks for macOS/Linux/Windows/npm, GitHub stars badge

Features page: detailed breakdown organized into categories (Core Account Management, Providers, Sessions & Recall, Fleet & Transfer, Context Layer, Security, Desktop/Browser Integration, MCP, TUI/Panel) with icons and descriptions pulled from docs/ARCHITECTURE.md

Documentation section: Installation (from README install section), Usage (everyday use from README), CLI Reference (all 130+ commands organized by category from README CLI section), Providers (from README providers section), Sessions (from README sessions section), Fleet (from README fleet section), MCP (from README MCP section)
Architecture page: content from docs/ARCHITECTURE.md with diagrams rendered as styled code blocks or ASCII art
Use Cases page: content from docs/USE-CASES.md organized as expandable/linked sections
Pricing page: placeholder tiers from docs/PRODUCTIZATION.md (Free/Pro/Team/Enterprise) with 'Coming Soon' badges, feature comparison table
FAQ page: common questions derived from README troubleshooting section and general usage patterns
Configure package.json scripts: dev, build, preview, and add .gitignore for node_modules and dist
acceptance_criteria: Running `cd website && npm install && npm run build` succeeds with zero errors
The dist/ directory contains both EN and TR versions of all pages
All pages have proper SEO meta tags (title, description, og:image placeholder)
Navigation works between all pages (internal links are correct)
Dark mode toggle is functional via class-based switching
Language switcher links correctly map EN pages to TR equivalents and vice versa
The site is fully responsive (mobile, tablet, desktop layouts)
Install commands are displayed in styled code blocks
CLI reference organizes 130+ commands into logical categories with descriptions
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/keyflip/website && npm install && npm run build
ls dist/ && ls dist/tr/ to confirm bilingual output exists
Check that dist/index.html contains expected landing page content
findings: Build produces 29 pages (14 EN + 14 TR + 404) in 1.07s. Used @tailwindcss/vite plugin directly (not @astrojs/tailwind which is for v3). Astro 5.9.3 with Tailwind CSS 4.3.3. The package-lock.json is included in the commit. All acceptance criteria verified: bilingual output, dark mode toggle, language switcher, SEO meta tags, responsive layout, CLI reference with 130+ commands organized by category.
